description: Pinned native runtime components of the BirkNext Windows Tester Package (TesterNative profile). Every input is an exact version from an official upstream source with a SHA-256 recorded here; the package build refuses any other bytes and never fetches 'latest'. Changing a version means changing this file in a reviewed commit.

postgresql.compatibleWith: postgres:16 developer container (16.13 at the time of pinning)
postgresql.source: EnterpriseDB Windows x64 binaries, the distribution linked from postgresql.org/download/windows
postgresql.checksumProvenance: EnterpriseDB publishes no checksum for this archive: the value is the SHA-256 of the archive downloaded over HTTPS from the official URL on 2026-11-11 (trust on first use). The binaries carry no Authenticode signature.
windowsPrerequisites: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64): vcruntime140.dll and msvcp140.dll are imported by the PostgreSQL binaries and not part of the archive

k6.checksumProvenance: Matches the upstream k6-v1.0.0-checksums.txt published with the release.

offlineTranslation.description: Embedded offline English -> Norwegian (bokmal) translation for Manual Testing: CTranslate2 (CPU, int8) with the HPLT v2.0 Marian model, run by a helper process with the embeddable Python runtime. Built by scripts/build-offline-translation.ps1 from these inputs only; the tester's PC never downloads anything.

python.checksumProvenance: SHA-256 of the archive downloaded over HTTPS from python.org on 2026-11-20 (trust on first use).

offlineTranslation.checksumProvenanceWheels: SHA-256 values as published by PyPI for these files. numpy and PyYAML are used only to convert the model while building; they are not shipped.

model.attribution: HPLT MT release v2.0 (English -> Norwegian Bokmal), the HPLT project (hplt-project.org), CC BY 4.0. Converted to CTranslate2 int8 by the BirkNext build; weights otherwise unchanged.
model.note: HPLT/translate-en-nb-v2.0-hplt_opus (HPLT + OPUS data) was the first choice, but its repository holds no weights (README only, checked 2026-11-20) and data.statmt.org has no copy; the HPLT-data model is used.
model.checksumProvenance: The weight and SentencePiece hashes equal the Git LFS object ids Hugging Face lists for the revision; the vocabulary and README are SHA-256 of the files downloaded over HTTPS on 2026-11-20.

windowsPrerequisites: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64), as for PostgreSQL: ctranslate2.dll imports msvcp140.dll (a copy vendored by the SentencePiece wheel is placed beside python.exe)

dotnet.note: The backend and the launcher are published self-contained for win-x64 with the .NET 8 runtime of the SDK that builds the package (recorded in config/runtime-manifest.json).
